description.value:
Vonil and Ishu are built for two, not one — a form meant to be practiced with an ally rather than alone. Guardians who follow this path move, strike, and defend in careful concert with a chosen partner, turning two separate fighters into a single coordinated unit.

Trust replaces individual flash as the core skill: a Vonil/Ishu duelist reads their partner's openings as readily as their own, setting up each other's attacks and covering each other's blind spots until neither can be caught alone.
